mapper.select: select count(1) from sc_follow where user_id = #{userId} and classify = 3
select count(1) from sc_follow sc left join goods g on g.good_id = sc.by_id where sc.user_id = #{userId} and sc.classify = 1 and g.good_id is not null

SELECT tu.user_name as userName,tu.avatar as avatar,sf.create_time as createTimeStr,sf.follow_id,sf.by_id, sf.classify FROM sc_follow sf left join tb_user tu on sf.by_id = tu.user_id WHERE sf.user_id = #{userId} AND sf.classify = 3

SELECT f.user_id,tu1.user_name AS userName, tu.avatar AS avatar, f.create_time AS createTimeStr, CASE WHEN m.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_mutual_follow FROM sc_follow AS f LEFT JOIN sc_follow AS m ON f.user_id = m.by_id AND f.classify = 3 AND m.classify = 3 LEFT JOIN tb_user tu ON f.by_id = tu.user_id left join tb_user tu1 on tu1.user_id = f.user_id WHERE f.by_id = #{userId} AND f.classify = 3
